name: Merge PDFs with Bookmarks per File

seo.title: Merge PDFs with Bookmarks per File — Browser-Local Tool
seo.meta_description: Merge multiple PDFs locally and add one top-level bookmark at the first page of each source file.

assumptions: Bookmark labels default to sanitized filenames and can be edited before export.
limitations: Encrypted files, signatures and complex interactive features may not survive merging; outline writing uses a tested integration helper that still requires deferred QA.
